method: We took the portable ENERGY STAR dehumidifiers with the highest certified Integrated Energy Factor (IEF). The score is 90% IEF and 10% capacity; yearly energy use is not scored separately because it follows from capacity and IEF. The five-year electricity cost is shown for each (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). Every model tied with the last one on the selection criterion is listed, so the cut never picks among equals.
name: The most energy-efficient dehumidifiers, ranked by certified efficiency
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

selection.label: Integrated Energy Factor
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 11 reported fields

ties.rule: equal scores share a rank; within it products are listed alphabetically (no measured difference)
